issues.description: The template uses the identifier 'ecc' as a CPU register in the instruction 'add eax, ecc' (template_repository/helloWorld.asm), while the problem statement explicitly instructs students to change 'ecc' to 'ecx' and the solution uses 'ecx'. This is an unintended naming/typo inconsistency of the same conceptual entity (the ECX register). It creates unnecessary confusion and a compile failure for students trying to map the problem instructions to the starter code.
issues.suggested_fix: In the template (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) replace the incorrect register name 'ecc' with 'ecx' (change the line 'add eax, ecc' to 'add eax, ecx') so the template, problem statement, and solution consistently refer to the same register.
